routes.json collector investigation (live-project)

1. Route registry format — source `src_b2dd364b…ffce` path `routes.json`, repo `repo.main`, sourceClass=config, contentHash ed7c0838…f102, byteLength 124 (declared: raw JSON read via read-source):
   {"routerId":"app","mode":"history","routes":[{"path":"/orders","name":"Orders"},{"path":"/inventory","name":"Inventory"}]} + CRLF terminator.
   Keys observed: top-level `routerId`, `mode`, `routes[]`; each route has `path` and optional `name`. No alias/title/i18n/component keys present in this file.

2. Identity contract (template schema, required slots in canonical order for kind `route`): scopeId, routerId, mode, declaredPath. A route identity therefore depends on the per-file router envelope (routerId+mode), not only on the route's own bytes. Evidence role for those envelope values = `identity`.
   - Effective routerId: explicit `routerId` string; otherwise derived fallback `${basename without extension}` (routes.json -> "routes") plus gap code ROUTER_ID_DERIVED so derivation is never silent.
   - Effective mode: explicit `mode`; else gap MODE_UNDECLARED and no route emitted (required slot, value not invented).
   - Missing/empty declared `path` => gap PATH_MISSING.

3. Scope: configSubset.scopes is [] and repositories has exactly one entry {id:"repo.main"}. Default scope = repo.<repositoryId> = repo.main, matched by prefix so future configured scopes (repo.main/...) win over the repository default.

4. Evidence model: whole-route-object byte span from JSON.parse reviver key-order (start=min offset of member keys, end=max offset of member value ends), line numbers computed from UTF-8 byte offsets against current text (CRLF handled); envelope evidence spans first envelope member key start through last member value end before `routes`, role `identity`. Non-object / non-string path entries are reported as gaps (INVALID_ROUTE_ENTRY / PATH_NOT_STRING), not coerced. Dynamic template placeholders in path (${...}) become DYNAMIC_PATH gaps.

5. Plugin shape: extract stage only, capability `routes`, entry src/routes.mjs, sourceSelectors include ["routes.json"], exclude [] , replacement=project, runtime node >=24 <25. write-candidate in this release exposes no includeIdentityHelper property, so identity.mjs ships as a declared artifact carrying the unmodified §3.3 template implementation (no project-specific changes) instead of being copied ad hoc per function.

6. Acceptance cases: normal two-route registry; same-name/different-router false-link probe; dynamic-value probe; missing-target/source-change probe. Fixtures built from the exported CollectorInput with stageId changed to extract.
